name: M'ONDUNIQ LASER-IQ Anti-Age Cream SPF 50
shortDescription: SPF 50 anti-age protective cream for skincare after laser, IPL and microneedling treatments. Photostable UVA/UVB filters, collagen, Matrixyl synthe'6 peptide and hyaluronic acid. 50 and 150 ml.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ LASER-IQ Anti-Age Cream SPF 50 is a professional mondoceutical protective cream developed specifically to support skin regeneration following laser, IPL, microneedling, radiofrequency, cold plasma and other intensive aesthetic treatments. It provides high SPF 50 sun protection while its targeted anti-age active ingredients support the skin's natural repair processes, reduce the risk of photoaging and help preserve treatment results.

After aesthetic procedures the skin can temporarily become more sensitive to UV radiation, which is why proper sun protection is one of the most important elements of the treatment protocol. The cream's modern, photostable UVA and UVB filters provide effective protection against the harmful effects of sunlight and help prevent the risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), pigment spots and light-induced collagen breakdown. This is especially important after collagen-stimulating treatments – laser skin rejuvenation, RF microneedling or microneedling – when the skin is going through intensive renewal processes.

Its advanced mondoceutical formula contains collagen, the biomimetic peptide Matrixyl synthe'6, hyaluronic acid, red clover extract, allantoin and vitamin E. The coordinated action of these active ingredients intensively hydrates, soothes and nourishes the skin, supports the restoration of the skin's natural protective layer, reduces transepidermal water loss (TEWL), improves elasticity and firmness, and helps reduce the visibility of fine lines and expression lines.

Its light, fast-absorbing, non-greasy, non-comedogenic texture leaves no white cast, provides all-day comfort and works perfectly as a makeup base. The product contains environmentally friendly UV filters that comply with the EcoSun Pass standard.

It is the ideal finishing product of the LASER-IQ treatment protocol. Specifically recommended after Q-switched ND:YAG Carbon Peeling, diode laser Skin Rejuvenation, IPL photorejuvenation, fractional and non-ablative laser treatments, microneedling treatments, RF microneedling, as well as cold plasma treatments and chemical peels – and in every case where the skin needs increased UV protection and regenerative support.

This product is not a conventional sunscreen: in addition to high-level UV protection, it contains mondoceutical active ingredients that support skin regeneration, hydration and anti-aging processes. Professional laser treatment does not end on the treatment bed – proper regeneration and daily SPF protection are at least as important as the treatment itself, so the cream can also be an essential part of clients' home skincare routine until the next appointment.

faq.answer: During professional aesthetic treatments the skin can temporarily become more sensitive to UV radiation, which is why proper sun protection is one of the most important elements of the treatment protocol.
